αἰγιόχοιο: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (of Zeus); epic gen. sg. -οιο (= Attic -ου); meaning disputed: usually ’holding the αἰγίς (goatskin shield)’, other derivations were proposed in antiquity
αἰχμητάων: αἰχμητής — spearman, warrior; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
αἴαντος: Αἴας — Ajax, son of Telamon; masc. gen. sg.
αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, son of Telamon, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
αἴτιοί: αἴτιος — responsible, to blame; masc. nom. pl.
αὐτίχ: αὐτίκα — at once, straightaway; adv., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (αὐτίχ’ = αὐτίκα)
αὐτὴν: αὐτός — self; fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also intensive, accusative subject of an infinitive: ’she herself’ (αὐτὴν ποθέσαι ’that she herself miss [him]’) · also attributive, ’the same’: τῷ αὐτὴν ὁδὸν ’the very same road’ · also intensive with a noun, ’very’: εἰς ὁδὸν αὐτὴν ’into the very path’ · also intensive with a pronoun object, ’you yourself’ (σὲ … αὐτήν)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’) · also masc. nom. sg., of a thing: ’it itself’ (αὐτὸς … σίδηρος ’iron of itself’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’) · also ’without more, empty-handed’, of sending away with no gift (αὔτως ἀππέμψει ’will send us off with nothing’) · also ’to no purpose, idly’, of testing: αὔτως … πειρητίζων ’testing (each man) to no purpose’ · also ’merely, only’, qualifying a kind (ἦ αὔτως οἷοί τε … κύνες ’or merely such as … dogs’) · also ’idly, as he is’, of lying (ἦ αὔτως κεῖται ’or does he lie there idle’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βασιλήων: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. pl., epic -ήων (= Attic -έων)
βούλομ: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. 1 sg. mid., elided (βούλομ’ = βούλομαι): ’I prefer’ (with ἤ ’rather than’)
βούλομαι: βούλομαι — wish, want, be minded; pres. 1 sg. mid., + inf.: ’I want’
βοῦς: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; acc. pl. · also masc./fem. nom. sg. (same spelling as the acc. pl.): ’the ox, the heifer’ (ἦλθε ... βοῦς ’the heifer came’)
γέρας: γέρας — privilege, honor, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δέδασται: δατέομαι — divide, share out; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been divided’
δέμας: δέμας — bodily form, frame; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect: ’in body’ · also neut. acc. sg., direct object or in apposition: ’body’ (εἶδός τε δέμας τε ’form and body’)
δευόμενον: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’lacking’
δόσαν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔδοσαν)
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’ · also of the upper air: αἰθέρα δῖαν ’the heavenly upper air’
δῷσι: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 3 sg.: ’may grant’
εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic form (unaccented after an accented word): ’I am’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
εἵνεκ: εἵνεκα (elided εἵνεκ’) — for the sake of, because of; prep. + gen., epic (= Attic ἕνεκα)
εἶμι: εἶμι — go, will go; pres. 1 sg. with future sense (= Attic fut. of ἔρχομαι): ’I am going, I will go’
εἶπας: εἶπον — say; aor. 2 sg. with the first-aorist ending -ας (= Attic εἶπες): ’you said’
εἷς: εἷς — one; numeral, masc. nom. sg. (ὁ μέν … εἷς δ’ … εἷς δ’ ’one … another … another’)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
ζεύς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θάμβησεν: θαμβέω — be astonished, marvel; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐθάμβησεν)
θεοπροπέων: θεοπροπέω — prophesy, utter oracles; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
θεός: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg. · also fem. nom. sg. ’goddess’ (δεινὴ θεός; θεός is common gender)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’) · also the seat of appetite: ’appetite’ (πλησαίατο θυμόν ’might satisfy their appetite’)
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελιηδέα θυμὸν ἀπηύρα ’took away (my) honey-sweet life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
κάκ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. (elided κάκ’): ’evils, misfortunes’ · also neut. nom. pl., elided (κάκ’ = κακά), agreeing with ἀράχνια: ’foul (cobwebs)’
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’) · also + subj. in a prospective relative clause: ’who shall’ (ὅς κέ με κεῖσ’ ἀγάγῃ ’who shall lead me there’) · also + fut. indic. (or short-vowel subj.) in a clause after εἴ: ’whether perhaps’ (εἴ κέ σφι … τελευτήσει ’whether … it will come to pass for them’) · also + opt., potential, in a main clause: ’might’ (καί κέ τεο … πειρηθεῖμεν ’we might test any of’) · also + impf. indic., unreal past: ‘would have been’ (καί κέ τοι … ἀμφεπονεῖτο ‘would have been busy for you’) · also + opt. in a relative clause: ‘from where you would’ (ὅθεν κέ τοι … ἄλφοι) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ἐπεί κέ τις ἀποπέσῃσιν ’whenever one has fallen off’)
κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge, exhort; pres. mid. 2 sg.
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
κείμενα: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. part. mid. neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’lying (there)’
κεχολώσεται: χολόω — anger; mid. χολόομαι ’be angry’; fut. perf. 3 sg. mid.: ’will be angry’
κηδομένη: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned; pres. part. mid./dep. fem. nom. sg.
κλισίην: κλισίη — seat, chair (general sense); fem. acc. sg. · also hut, shelter (the usual epic sense): ’to my hut’ (ἐς κλισίην ἄγαγον ’I led you to my hut’)
κορωνίσιν: κορωνίς — curved, with a curved stern (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισιν, agreeing with νηυσί/νήεσσι
κουριδίης: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a wife); fem. gen. sg., epic -ης (= Attic -ας)
κούρης: κούρη — girl, maiden, daughter (Attic κόρη); fem. gen. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ‘wide-ruling’)  ·  also honorific of a chief steward, not a king: κρείων Ἐτεωνεύς ’the lord Eteoneus’
κύδιστε: κύδιστος — most glorious, greatest; masc. voc. sg., superlative, address
λίσσομαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. 1 sg., + gen. of the power invoked · also + acc. of the person entreated (and acc. of the thing asked): οὐχ ὑμέας ἔτι λίσσομαι ’I no longer beg you’ · also used absolutely, the addressee already given by context and left unexpressed, with the ground of the appeal in a following clause (λίσσομαι, εἴ ποτέ ...)
λαμπετόωντι: λαμπετάω — blaze, gleam, flash (extended epic form of λάμπω); pres. part. neut./masc. dat. sg., uncontracted: ’blazing’
λαοὺς: λαός — people, folk, crowd; masc. acc. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάχαι: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. nom. pl.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. noun, not adverbial: κῦμα μέγ’ ’a great wave’
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’) · also standing for a noun left out: ’a black (ewe)’ (θῆλύν τε μέλαιναν)
μένειν: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. inf. act.
μένεος: μένος — might, fury, passion; neut. gen. sg., genitive of cause: ’with fury’
μαντεύεσθαι: μαντεύομαι — prophesy, divine; pres. inf. mid.
μεγάθυμοι: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. nom. pl.
μερμήριξεν: μερμηρίζω — ponder, waver, be in doubt; aor. 3 sg.: ’pondered’
μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
μητίετα: μητίετα — counsellor, wise in counsel (epithet of Zeus); masc. nom. sg., epic -α
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μυρμιδόνεσσιν: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic -σι)
μόγησα: μογέω — toil, labour, suffer hardship; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented: ’I toiled’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’ · also negating a generic relative clause with the opt.: ὃς μὴ … ἐλάσειε ’whoever did not drive off’ · also ’lest’ in a warning, + 2 sg. fut./subj.: μὴ … ἀποτίσεαι ’lest you pay for it’ · also + inf., negating an infinitive of advice that gives the content of a word: ’not to’ (ἔπος … μὴ πάντα μνηστῆρσιν ὁμιλεῖν ’a word, not to mingle in everything with the suitors’) · also negating a generic relative clause with the subj.: ᾧ μὴ πολλοὶ ἔωσιν ’who has not many’ · also μή + subj. in a clause of apprehension after a verb of looking: ’lest, in case’ (ἴδοι μὴ δὴ σχεδὸν ὦσι ’let him see whether they are near’)
νηΐ: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. sg., epic νηΐ (diaeresis marks the two syllables), of means: ’by ship’
νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἴκοι: οἴκοι — at home; adv. (locative of οἶκος)
οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’ · also agreeing with a named dative: ’to Tiresias alone’ (Τειρεσίῃ … οἴῳ), ’he alone’ (τῷ … οἴῳ) · also agreeing with τοι ’you’: ’you alone’ (τοι οἴῳ) · also agreeing with the encl. dat. οἱ: ’to him alone’ (οἱ οἴῳ)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οἶος: οἶος — alone, only; masc. nom. sg.
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐρανόθεν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; adv. οὐρανόθεν, -θεν ’from’: ’from the sky’
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
οὕτως: οὕτω(ς) — so, thus, in this way; adv.
πάρ: παρά — beside, along; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε ’threw beside’) · also πάρα (elided πάρ’) = πάρεστι, πάρεισι: ’is at hand, are at hand’ (πάρ’ ὀϊστοί ’arrows are at hand’)
πίμπλαντ: πίμπλημι — fill; impf. pass. 3 pl., elided (πίμπλαντ’ = πίμπλαντο): ’were filling, were being filled’
παλλάδ: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena; fem. acc. sg., elided (Παλλάδ’ = Παλλάδα)
πείσεις: πείθω — persuade, win over; fut. 2 sg.
πηλεΐωνα: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles; masc. acc. sg., patronymic
πηλεΐωνι: Πηλεΐων — son of Peleus, i.e. Achilles (patronymic); masc. dat. sg.
πλεῖον: πλείων — more, greater; comparative of πολύς; neut. nom. sg. (Attic πλέον): ’more (of it)’ · also πλεῖος — full (of), + gen.; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μέγαρον (πλεῖον δαιτυμόνων ’full of banqueters’)
ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολίων: πόλις — city; fem. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πόλεων)
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’) · also neut. acc. pl., adjectival with a noun: ’many’ (πολλά τε δῶρα ’and many gifts’)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial with a negative: ’far’ (οὐ πολὺ ναῖεν ’did not live far off’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with κάλλος: ’much’ (κάλλος πολύ ’much beauty’)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, formerly; enclitic adv. · also with μή, ’ever’: μή ποτε ’never’ · also with οὐ, ’ever’: οὔ ποτε ’never’
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
πρὸ: πρό — before, in front; prep. + gen.; also adv. or preverb in tmesis, ’ahead, forward’ (πρὸ … ἔαξεν ’broke ahead’)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’) · also + gen., of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς Βορέαο ’toward the North Wind’) · also + gen., in an appeal: ’by (your father)’ (πρὸς πατρὸς γουνάζομαι) · also as preverb in tmesis: με πρὸς μῦθον ἔειπε = με προσέειπε μῦθον ’spoke a word to me’ · also + gen., ’in the eyes of, with’ (πρὸς πόσιός τε καὶ υἱέος ’in the eyes of her husband and son’)
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usu. with a negative
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
σ: σύ — you (sg.); encl. acc. sg., elided (σ’ = σε): ’you’ · also σός — your, yours; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (σ’ = σά): τὰ σ’ αὐτοῦ κήδε’ ’your own troubles’
σέθεν: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σέθεν (= Attic σοῦ)
σκιόεντα: σκιόεις — shadowy, dim; neut. acc. pl.
σοῖς: σός — your, yours; masc./neut. dat. pl.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας: ’your (prize)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆρ as subject: ’your (heart)’ (σὸν κῆρ ἰανθῇ)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also adverb ’along, with (us)’ construed with ἔχοντες, which takes the object (σὺν … χεῖρας ἔχοντες ’having hands along with us’)
σῶν: σός — your, yours; masc. gen. pl. (agreeing with ἑτάρων)
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg. (φίλον τέκος ’dear child’)
τήνδ: ὅδε — this, this here; fem. acc. sg., elided (τήνδ’ = τήνδε): ’this’
τήνδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this (here); demonstrative pron., fem. acc. sg.
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ὅπως, accented before enclitic μοι: ’any’ (τί … ἄλγος ’any pain’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective after ἤ, accented before the enclitic μοι: ’any’ (ἤ τί μοι … κειμήλιον ’or any treasure of mine’) · also the enclitic indefinite as a substantive object after εἴ: ’anything’ (εἴ τί μιν εἴποι ’whether she would say anything to him’) · also enclitic indefinite adjective, accented before enclitic μοι: ’some’ (σῆμά τί μοι ’some sign for me’)
τίπτ: τίπτε (= τί ποτε) — why ever, why then; interrog. adv., elided (τίπτ’ = τίπτε)
ταῦθ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (ταῦθ’ = ταῦτα)
ταῦτ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ταῦτ’ = ταῦτα): ‘these things’
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τελέεσθαι: τελέω — bring to pass, accomplish, fulfil; fut. inf. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic τελεῖσθαι)
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, privilege, worth; acc. sg. · also compensation, the price set on a wrong; acc. sg., object of ἄγοντες: ’a payment’ (τιμὴν … ἐεικοσάβοιον ’a payment worth twenty oxen’)
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῦδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. gen. sg., elided (τοῦδ’ = τοῦδε)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’; may anticipate a following clause: ’this (namely that…)’ · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (φάρμακον … τό σφιν πόρε ’the drug which she gave them’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg., subject of its clause: ’which’ (τό κε κέρδιον εἴη ’which would be better’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: gen. pl. ’of whom, whose’ (τῶν ὕβρις τε βίη τε … ἵκει ’whose insolence and violence reach’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάσθαι: φημί — say, speak; pres. inf. mid., epic φάσθαι (= Attic φάναι)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρτερόν: φέρτερος — better, stronger; comparative (suppletive to ἀγαθός); neut. nom. sg., predicate
φέρτερός: φέρτερος — stronger, better; masc. nom. sg., predicate, accented before the enclitic εἰμί: ’stronger’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’ · also plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’dear’ (τέκνα φίλα ’dear children’) · also neut. acc. pl. as substantive, object: ’dear things, kindnesses’ (φίλα ἔρδοι ’may do kindnesses’)
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
φεῦγε: φεύγω — flee, escape; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφευγε): ’he fled’
φθίην: Φθίη — Phthia, Achilles’ homeland in Thessaly; fem. acc. sg.
φρένα: φρήν — mind, wits, heart; acc. sg. · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (γέγηθε φρένα ’is glad in heart’)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
φυήν: φυή — stature, natural growth, form; fem. acc. sg.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
χαίρῃς: χαίρω — rejoice, take delight in (+ dat.); pres. subj. 2 sg.: ’you may delight’
χερείων: χερείων — worse, inferior; epic comparative of κακός (= Attic χείρων); masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγείρομεν: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; pres. subj. 1 pl., short-vowel hortatory (= Attic ἀγείρωμεν): ’let us gather’
ἀγορεύεις: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare, say; pres. 2 sg.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀλόχου: ἄλοχος — wife; fem. gen. sg., with πρός · also fem. gen. sg. as object of πειράω (+ gen.): ’of your wife’ (σῆς ἀλόχου πειρήσεαι ’you will make trial of your wife’) · also fem. gen. sg., with ἐκ: ’of a wedded wife’ (ἐξ ἀλόχου ’by a wife’) · also fem. gen. sg., depending on a noun: ’of his wife’ (εὐνῆς ἧς ἀλόχου ταρπήμεναι ’to have his fill of the bed of his own wife’)
ἀμφιμέλαιναι: ἀμφιμέλας — black all about, black on both sides; fem. nom. pl., epithet of φρένες
ἀπολέσθαι: ἀπόλλυμι (mid. ἀπόλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed; aor. mid. inf.: ‘to perish’
ἀρχὸς: ἀρχός — leader, chief; masc. nom. sg.
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
ἀτρεΐδην: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic, here of Agamemnon); masc. acc. sg.  ·  also used of Menelaus: Ἀτρεΐδην Μενέλαον ’Menelaus, son of Atreus’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφαιρεῖται: ἀφαιρέω — take away; mid. take away for oneself, snatch; pres. 3 sg. mid.
ἀχνύμενος: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες) · also = ἀνά as a preposition + acc.: ’up through, up among’ (ἂν δόνακας ’up through the reeds’) · also in ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἂν … ἑλοίμεθα ’so that we might seize’) · also in ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., purpose after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἑλοίμην ’so that I might take’)
ἂρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, grave form ἂρ (ἐπεὶ ἂρ δή ’since, as it seems’)
ἄγω: ἄγω — lead, carry, bring; pres. 1 sg. · also pres. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’am I to bring?’ (ἦε σοὶ ἐνθάδ’ ἄγω ’or am I to bring him here to you’)
ἄλγεα: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’ · also fem. dat. sg. adjective, ’(at) another (woman)’ (ἄλλῃ νεμεσῶ) · also fem. dat. sg. attributive: ’(in) another (place)’ (ἄλλῃ ἐνὶ χώρῃ)
ἄμεινον: ἀγαθός — good; comparative ἀμείνων, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’better’
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual pron./adj., used with a dual verb · also with a plural noun: ἄμφω χεῖρας ’both hands’ · also in apposition to a plural subject: ’both of us’ (ἱκόμεθ’ ἄμφω)
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also in ὄφρ’ ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρ’ ἄν ἔχῃς ’so that you may keep’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that … might’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that anyone … would call you blessed’)
ἄνασσε: ἀνάσσω — be lord over, rule; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, + gen.: ’was lord over’
ἄντην: ἄντην — face to face, to the eye, in front; adv.
ἄξω: ἄγω — lead, take; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will take’
ἄφενος: ἄφενος — wealth, abundance; neut. nom. sg.
ἄχος: ἄχος — grief, pain, distress; neut. nom. sg.
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. ἅλς, ’salt’ (the seasoning), as in οὐδ’ ἅλα ’not even salt’
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐδηλήσαντ: δηλέομαι — harm, hurt, injure; aor. 3 pl. mid., elided (ἐδηλήσαντ’ = ἐδηλήσαντο)
ἐθέλεις: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, intend; pres. 2 sg.
ἐλθέμεναι: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. inf. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἐλθεῖν): ‘to come’
ἐμαὶ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. nom. pl.
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl. · also neut. dat. pl., agreeing with μεγάροισιν: ’my (halls)’
ἐμὰς: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with φρένας
ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — here, to this place; adv.
ἐξαλαπάξαι: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, raze; aor. inf.
ἐπέοικε: ἐπέοικα (ἐπείκω) — be fitting, befit; perf. 3 sg., present sense: ’it befits’
ἐπιτηδὲς: ἐπιτηδές — on purpose, in earnest; adv. (Attic ἐπίτηδες)
ἐρέτας: ἐρέτης — rower, oarsman; masc. acc. pl.
ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of launching a ship: ’having drawn down, having launched’ · also of a sword, ’drawing (from the sheath)’: ξίφος ὀξὺ ἐρυσσάμενος ’having drawn a sharp sword’
ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut./masc. acc. sg.
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐτράπετ: τρέπω — turn; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐτράπετ’ = ἐτράπετο): ’turned, changed’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑλών: αἱρέω — take, choose; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’picking out, choosing’ · also ’taking hold of, seizing’ (γούναθ’ ἑλών ’grasping the knees’)
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’) · also prep. + gen. with a particle between it and its noun: ἔκ γε γυναικός ’at the hands of a woman’
ἔμ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (ἔμ’ = ἐμέ): ’me’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ + dat. (θεοῖσιν ἔοικε ’he is like the gods’)
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’) · also = ἔπεστι, accented on the first syllable when it stands for the verb: ’there is (upon)’ · also as preverb in tmesis, placed after its object: ἔπι … ὦρσεν = ἐπῶρσεν ’stirred up (against)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’on, upon’ (οὐδοῦ ἔπι ξεστοῦ ’on the polished threshold’) · also + acc., postpositive with anastrophe, of place: ’over, upon’ (γαῖαν ἔπι ’over the earth’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔρις: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contest; fem. nom. sg.
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be’ · also as a copula with a predicate, personal: ’let (no one) be (gentle, etc.)’ (μή τις … πρόφρων … ἔστω ’let no one be ready-minded’)
ἔχειν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. inf. · also used as an imperative, a regular Homeric idiom for commands: ’hold (him) fast!’ (αὖθι δ’ ἔχειν μεμαῶτα)
ἔχῃς: ἔχω — have, hold, keep; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’ ἄν: ’so that you may keep’
ἔω: εἰμί — be; pres. subj. 1 sg., epic (= Attic ὦ), with ἄν: ’I may be’
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλκετο: ἕλκω — draw, drag; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic εἵλκετο): ’drew to himself’
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἠμείβετο, elided ἠμείβετ’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ) · also introducing the first alternative of a question: ’whether’ (ἠὲ διεπράθετο … ἦ … ’whether it was sacked … or …’) · also ’than’, after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖος … ἠὲ πάροιθεν ’different than before’) · also ’than’ after a comparative or word of preference (βέλτερόν ἐστι … ἠὲ ’it is better … than’) · also introducing the first alternative of a command: ’either’ (ἠὲ σὺ πρῶτος ἔσελθε ’either you go in first’)
ἤλυθον: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 1 sg., augmented, epic root ἐλυθ- with epenthetic -υ- (= Attic ἦλθον): ’I have come’ · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they came’
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also used as a vocative in direct address, inserted mid-sentence (ἥρως, εἴρεσθαι δέ ’and ask, hero that you are’), distinct from its use as a narrative title ’the hero’
ἦε: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), spelled ἦε in ἦε καὶ οὐκί ’or not’
ἧκε: ἵημι — send, let go, let fall; aor. 3 sg. (with κὰδ in tmesis: ’let down’) · also of hurling a missile: ’hurled’ (ἧκε … κορυφὴν ὄρεος ’hurled the peak of a mountain’) · also with ἐν in tmesis: ’put in’ (ἐν … ἧκε) · also with ὑπό in tmesis: ’set beneath’ (ὑπὸ θρῆνυν … ἧκε ’set a footstool beneath’) · also with πρό in tmesis: ’sent forth’ (πρὸ … ἧκε)
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’ · also ’until’ + optative, of an expected end (ἧος θερμαίνοιτο ’until it should grow hot’)
ἧσθαι: ἧμαι — sit, be seated; pres. inf.: ’to sit’ (subject of ἔοικε, with an accusative subject of its own) · also pres. inf. standing for an order: ’sit!’ (ἀναβᾶσα … ἧσθαι ’go up … and sit’)
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretan contingent at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem εἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱερὰ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; neut. acc. pl. ’sacred rites, offerings’ · also attributive, agreeing with δώματα: ’sacred (halls)’ (ἱερὰ πρὸς δώματα)
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’
ἴμεν: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι)
ἵκηται: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. subj. 3 sg. (short ι; subjunctives take no augment)
ἵκωμαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at; aor. subj. 1 sg. mid., after εἴ κεν: ’I should come to’ · also deliberative, in a question: ’am I to come to’ (τεῦ δώμαθ’ ἵκωμαι ’to whose halls am I to come’)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’ · also + opt. after a future main verb: ’so that … may’ (ἄξω … ἵνα … ἄλφοι ’I will take … so that he may bring in’)
ἶσον: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. nom. sg., with οὔρεϊ: ’equal to a mountain’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’equally, as much as’ (ἶσον Ἀχιλλῆος … ἀχνύμεθα ’we grieve as much as for Achilles’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τόν, + dat.: ’like, equal to’ (ἔρνεϊ ἶσον ’like a sapling’)
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, the poem’s hero; nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀλέσσῃ: ὄλλυμι — destroy, kill; aor. subj. 3 sg., epic -εσσ-, in a purpose clause
ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a little’ (ὀλίγον προγενέστερος ’a little older’)
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀσσόμενος: ὄσσομαι — see before one, picture to oneself, foresee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὁμοιωθήμεναι: ὁμοιόω — make like, make equal; aor. pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic ὁμοιωθῆναι): ’to be made equal’ (μῆτιν ὁμοιωθήμεναι ’to be matched in cunning’)
ὁμῶς: ὁμῶς — alike, in like manner, equally; adv.
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὄπιθεν: ὄπιθεν — from behind, hereafter, in time to come; adv., with the directional suffix -θεν · also ’behind’, of those left at home, no motion from (τῶν ὄπιθεν ’those behind’) · also with a verb of going, ’off behind’ (ἰὼν ὄπιθεν ’going off behind’) · also ’behind (one’s) back, in secret’ (κακῶς δ’ ὄπιθεν φρονέουσι ’think ill behind (one’s) back’)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’) · also ὄφρ’ ἂν + opt., ’until … should’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἄγοιεν ’until they should carry’) · also temporal + subj. without ἄν or κε, ’so long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἀρετὴν παρέχωσι … καὶ γούνατ’ ὀρώρῃ ’so long as the gods furnish excellence and his knees are stirring’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅπως: ὅπως — so that, in order that, how; + subj. or fut. indic. · also + opt., in secondary sequence after a past-tense verb, indirect deliberative: ’how it might’ (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also ’when’ = ὅτε · also ’as, however’ + subj. in a general clause: ὅπως ἐθέλῃσιν ’however he wishes’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might follow’ (ὅπως … ἑποίατο) · also + pres. indic., ’as, in whatever way’ (ὅπως ἐθέλεις ’as you wish’) · also ’how’ + aor. indic., indirect question after a verb of telling (κατάλεξον ὅπως ἤντησας ’tell how you came upon’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν, in an indirect exclamation: ’how great (a host)’ · also acc. of duration, correlative with τόσσον: ’as long as’ (τόσσον χρόνον ὅσσον ’so long a time as’)
ὑπόδρα: ὑπόδρα — with a scowl, ’from under the brows’ (ancient explanation; derivation uncertain); adv.
ὕβριν: ὕβρις — insolence, wanton violence; fem. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’) · also ὡς ὅθ’ (= ὡς ὅτε), ’as when’, comparing with an occasion in the past (ὡς ὅθ’ ὑπὸ Τροίην ’as when beneath Troy’) · also introducing an indirect statement after a verb of saying: ’that, how’ (εἴποιμ’ ὡς … ἔρχομαι ’I might tell how I am coming’) · also ὡς ἄν + opt., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἄν τίς σε … μακαρίζοι ’so that someone … would call you blessed’) · also ὡς + participle, ’as one who’ (ὡς ἐκ θανάτοιο φυγόντα ’as one escaped from death’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν … ἔρχησθον ’so that you two may go’) · also ὡς = ’to, toward’ + acc. of a person (ὡς τὸν ὁμοῖον ’to the like’) · also exclamatory ὡς + finite verb: ’how’ (ὡς ὁ μολοβρὸς … ἀγορεύει ’how the glutton talks’) · also ὡς ’that, how’ introducing the content of a plan (νόον … ὡς ἦ τοι κείνους Ὀδυσεὺς ἀποτίσεται ’the plan that Odysseus would repay them’)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὥρμαινε: ὁρμαίνω — ponder, turn over in the mind, debate; impf. 3 sg., augmented (ο→ω): ’was pondering’
ὧδε: ὧδε — here, to this place, in this way; adv.
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ῥέξας: ῥέζω — do, perform (a sacrifice); aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having performed’ · also general, not of a sacrifice, ’do, act (to someone)’: οὔτε τινὰ ῥέξας ἐξαίσιον
